title: Jonas Brothers Add Third Concert at Madison Square Garden Following ‘Unreal’ Demand
summary: The MSG dates are all part of the JoBros’ The Burning Up Tour All Over Again, produced by Live Nation.
contentText:
Three is the magic number for Jonas Brothers ’ New York fans.

The sibling trio add a third show at Madison Square Garden — home of the NBA champion Knicks — following “overwhelming demand” during the initial presale, reps say.

Kevin, Joe, and Nick Jonas will now play a weekend date at the Garden on Saturday, Aug. 22, in addition to the previously announced shows Aug. 20 and 21.

The MSG dates are all part of the JoBros’  The Burning Up Tour All Over Again , produced by Live Nation.

“The response from our fans this week has been unreal, and we didn’t want anyone to miss out,” the Jonas Brothers remark in a statement. “Adding a third night at The Garden means more of you can relive this with us.”

The timing is sweet. Almost two decades ago , the original  Camp Rock  premiered just ahead of the brothers’ Burning Up Tour . Now here we are in 2026, with Camp Rock 3  premiering Aug. 13 on Disney Channel before streaming on Disney+ from Aug. 14, just two days before the Jonas Brothers’ induction on Aug. 16 as Disney Legends, one of The Walt Disney Company’s highest honors.

“The original Burning Up Tour was an exhilarating time in our lives,” the bros’ statement continues, “and getting to do it all over again, while celebrating everything that’s happened since, means the world to us. We can’t wait to run it back.”

The first  Camp Rock  aired on Disney Channel in 2008, propelling the Jonas Brothers and Demi Lovato to global superstardom. A sequel arrived in 2010.

“The movie’s super fun, I’m so excited,” Nick said during a recent stint on The Tonight Show . “Demi’s producing, and me and the brothers have a little cameo in it, which was so bizarre. What a cool thing.”

Tickets for all three nights at the Garden will go on sale from Friday, July 10 at 10am ET at ticketmaster.com . Additional presales run today, July 9.
